scope: Exact rational polygon coverage for entire surfaces, no sampling. Projection displacement is along one coordinate axis, so its absolute magnitude is a rigorous Euclidean point-to-surface upper bound. Oriented and unoriented results separated. An embedding failure still blocks ordinary occupied-solid equivalence.
